Midweek Roll

Atlanta, GA · Cabbagetown · Social

Midweek Roll is a social group ride in Atlanta, GA. It rolls every other Wednesday at 7:30 pm from 97 Estoria. About 10–12 miles, 10–12 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at @midweek_roll the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Midweek Roll group ride

A slow social loop through intown Atlanta neighborhoods that starts and ends at a bar. Ten to twelve miles at a talking pace. Helmets and lights required. Runs every other Wednesday; check Instagram for the next date.
